overview: The School Committee adopted state laws regarding wind instrument hygiene notifications and approved a resolution supporting the Medford Conversations Project. The meeting also included reports on new credit recovery protocols, health education implementation, and science program initiatives.

items.title: Adoption of MGL Chapter 71, Section 55D
items.summary: Adopted state legislation requiring schools to notify parents that issued wind instruments are sanitized and may be sterilized at the parent's expense.

items.title: Routine Administrative Business
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes from November 21, 2016, bills, fund transfers, and payroll.

items.title: Medford Conversations Project Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting the Medford Conversations Project to promote community dialogue on race and ethnicity. The committee discussed the importance of public officials taking a visible stance against intolerance.

items.title: Science Program Initiatives
items.summary: Reviewed various K-12 science grants and requested a follow-up report on the progress of a committee tasked with selecting a new science curriculum.

items.title: Credit Recovery Protocol
items.summary: Approved a protocol for in-district online credit recovery using the Edmentum platform to allow for better monitoring of student content mastery.

items.title: Michigan Model Health Education Program
items.summary: Discussed the implementation of a new social-emotional health curriculum and requested a draft policy for staff handling incidents like sexting that occur outside of school hours.

items.title: Professional Development Schedule
items.summary: Accepted the report designating Monday, March 13, 2017, as a professional development day for faculty.

items.title: Educator Evaluation Regulation Changes
items.summary: Reviewed proposed state-level changes regarding how student learning impact is embedded into teacher performance ratings.

items.title: School Nutrition Equipment Grant
items.summary: Accepted a grant to purchase new convection ovens for the McGlynn Middle and Columbus Elementary schools.

items.title: Recreational Marijuana Law Correspondence
items.summary: Approved a letter to the state delegation requesting enhanced regulations and clarity on local implementation of the new recreational marijuana law.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates
items.summary: Announced a groundbreaking event for the community access channel and provided updates on incoming federal education leadership.
